notes: 55-inch 4K UHD (3840x2160) Android-powered commercial signage display, 500 cd/m², part of Philips D-Line series (43/50/55BDL4550D share the same chassis and I/O panel). Ports and labels confirmed against both the official Philips/PPDS spec sheet (documents.philips.com, issue date 2024-03-24, EAN 87 12581 76925 3) and the full user manual (documents.philips.com, section 2.2 Input/Output Terminals) for 43BDL4550D_50BDL4550D_55BDL4550D. RS232 IN/OUT are 2.5mm sub-mini jacks (not DE-9), per the spec sheet's explicit '(in/out) 2.5mm jack' notation and manual panel diagram — no grade applies. IR IN/OUT are 3.5mm jacks used for IR pass-through/loop-through; connecting IR IN disables the built-in remote sensor. PC LINE IN is a 3.5mm analog audio input paired with the VGA/DVI-I input path; AUDIO OUT is a 3.5mm analog line output. Video input grades: HDMI1/HDMI2 confirmed HDMI 2.0 by manufacturer spec; DisplayPort IN/OUT confirmed DisplayPort 1.2. DVI-I IN has no bandwidth grade in the connector-grade scale (DVI is not gradeable per the given schema) so grade is omitted. USB 2.0 x2 ports are host/service ports for media playback (USB flash drives), not general bidirectional data ports in the AV-signal sense, but per instructions USB ports are marked bidirectional with usb-2.0 grade. A Micro SD card slot exists on the panel but has no corresponding connector id in the allowed list, so it was omitted (not a standard AV physical port type covered by the schema). Power: display uses a detachable IEC AC inlet (mains power 100-240 VAC, "AC Power Cord" included accessory, cord "varies depending on destination" per manual) — mapped to the closest listed connector, iec (C13/C14 family); exact IEC sub-type (C13 vs. a locking variant) not explicitly stated in the documentation. Desktop/wall-mount display — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. No RS422/RS485/Ethernet-based control beyond the single RJ45 (LAN control, not bandwidth-graded — used for CMND management/network control, not AV signal, so no eth grade assigned per spec sheet which lists it only as "RJ45" external control with no speed given).
